t: You're looking at the White House and its garden walls, a protected architectural structure in Greenwich. This was the home of the artist Christabel Airy, who both lived and died here. Born in 1842, she died in 1917. She was the daughter of Sir George Biddell Airy, which is why her name sits in this part of Greenwich's story. The records say little more, so imagine her here, a painter in a house with its walled garden around it.
